reviews.comment: Prof. Katz is literally the sweetest human. She is so understanding of things going on in your life outside of class. You do need to read and do well, but she gives you a lot of room to make a good grade even if you mess up here and there. The final project is REALLY important, it totally saved my grade.

Dr. Katz provides an enjoyable learning experience. Took the class because it was required for my degree but it's a class you can gain a lot from. You do have to read quite a bit but is manageable. The Class observations are an innovative way to apply what you learn from lecture in the real world. She is very caring and her lectures are enjoyable.
Dr. Katz is a wonderful professor. While her course (PHIL 489) was very easy, she improved my writing and taught me a lot. Definitely recommend her.

Loved her! She really cared about you and your grades. Was lenient on essay due dates and you can submit them as many times as needed to get a good grade. Tests were fairly easy as long as you understand what is going on in class.

She is extremely liberal in her viewpoints. If you are not into philosophy or liberal, I would not take this class. There are 3 classroom observation papers, 2 tests, and a final presentation. She is a hard grader on the papers. The class typically involves discussions and your participation matters. TONS OF READING. Not an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: By far my favorite professor I have ever had. She is very open minded and sweet. The readings aren't difficult and are quite interesting.  Class lectures are really just group discussions. Wish I could have taken her for more classes!!
